# An ESR release selector joins the project map to update-verification inputs

The project map supplies release_type in get_decision_parameters. add_command resolves keyed extra data using that release type, then indexes INCLUDE_VERSION_REGEXES with the chosen include-version key before adding the command option. The ESR 128 rollback changes this connected group along with release tasks and scope maps; fixed accepted source uses later ESR 153 keys and values. When changing this path, trace the project/release_type/selector/regex join together. Historical branch numbers and Balrog rule IDs are not current release policy. No generated task, update verification or release operation ran.

Scope: Taskgraph ESR release parameter flow.
